in_marathi.name: Narayani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narayani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narayani is the name of the goddess who is the consort of Vishnu, the preserver god in Hindu mythology. She is also known as Vishnu's shakti, or divine energy. The name Narayani comes from the word 'Narayana', which means 'the one who rests in water'. As the goddess of Gods, Narayani is the embodiment of compassion, love, and nurturing energy.
